Which School District 42 schools serve Mid Meadows in Pitt Meadows?

Public schools serving or located near Mid Meadows include Highland Park Elementary (18961 Advent Rd, K-7), Pitt Meadows Elementary (11941 Harris Rd, French Immersion K-7), and Pitt Meadows Secondary (19438 116B Ave, 8-12). Always verify exact street-address catchment boundaries using the official School District 42 (Maple Ridge – Pitt Meadows) locator before removing subjects.
What parks, trails, and recreation facilities are near Mid Meadows?
Residents of Mid Meadows enjoy access to Pitt Meadows Athletic Park and Pitt Meadows Arena Complex (11435 Bonson Rd), Grabenhorst Garden, and MacLean Park. See our companion

How are roads, West Coast Express access, and commuting in Mid Meadows?

Primary commuter and road corridors serving Mid Meadows include Bonson Road, Hammond Road, Wildwood Crescent, Advent Road, Lougheed Highway (Hwy 7), and nearby Maple Meadows West Coast Express Station, connecting residents to Lougheed Highway (Hwy 7), Dewdney Trunk Road, the Golden Ears Bridge, and TransLink RapidBus (R3) and West Coast Express commuter rail stations.
What zoning, Official Community Plan, or ALR rules apply in Mid Meadows?

Mid Meadows lies inside the Pitt Meadows Urban Containment Boundary under Zoning Bylaw No. 2505, 2011 and the 2040 Official Community Plan, combining R-1 single-family residential streets with multi-family strata developments along Bonson Rd, Hammond Rd, and 198B St near the Maple Ridge border. What are the 2021 Statistics Canada Census demographics for Mid Meadows?
